description: This file is a shell script that sets up and tests Git pre-push hooks in various scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with setup and assertions.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after test completion.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a file or path does not exist.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up or invokes a Git hook for testing purposes.
